scope: New installation and compatible app-only update. No old device history, registry, readonly qualification, migration grant or user proof fields.

fields.console: Existing fixed board profile: composite CDC / USB Serial-JTAG, no architecture change
fields.app_identity: Validated ESP appended image digest, embedded version and project from actual app bytes. Distinct from whole-file SHA.
fields.schemas: Current first-public layouts only; constants route to SCHEMAS and corresponding persistence contracts, not a legacy reader-floor proof.
fields.build: Exact current source_commit, inputs_sha256, effective sdkconfig_sha256, compile_recipe_sha256 and pinned idf_commit; before/after build inputs unchanged. Dirty source is represented by actual input hash, not falsely labeled as committed.
fields.files: Exactly bootloader, partition_table, otadata, app, model; each basename/offset/size/SHA256 from actual files. Bounds and aligned erase span are fixed by routed source.

installation.first_install: Full private original flash backup then fixed five-artifact write; preserve default NVS, protected factory/PHY sectors, memo_meta and SD. Only normal addressed sectors are erased by esptool.
installation.app_only: Verify bootloader, partition table and model exact dependencies before write; back up exact aligned app write span; write only app. No implicit reset or erase of business state.
installation.integrity: Normalize/freeze bundle artifact bytes in the private run before device work. Validate candidate byte hashes, app format/identity, complete board partition layout and offset/size bounds. ROM chip, capacity and security preflight precede backup/programming. No force, whole-chip erase, eFuse programming or SD access.
installation.failures: Restore only original addressed sectors, verify restored bytes and protected regions; remain in ROM. Unknown restoration never becomes successful recovery. A failed reset after successful write remains flash-verified/boot-unconfirmed.
installation.privacy: No MAC, ports, personal URL, sdkconfig/ELF or history in bundle. Device logs/backups/private result use private/install-runs.
installation.bootstrap_boundary: ROM cannot prove board pins/model. Operator selects confirmed supported board. Software download must actually be reachable on installed firmware; no assumption about inaccessible enclosure buttons. Real installation/return/normal-update retention remain R12.

build_source_identity: source_commit is own Git HEAD or source-sha256 of archive build sources/tooling, defined by scripts/source_identity.py; never inherited ancestor Git. Actual inputs_sha256/compile recipe/artifact hashes remain authoritative even with uncommitted edits.
